mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening residential demand, which triggers a broader contraction in consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 100.0 (index base 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and reduced corporate profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in private demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS are below threshold (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to outperform individual proxies in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% during a period of stable or declining inflation signals a tightening monetary cycle, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces positive returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% and decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal fails to outperform individual series in 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 440,000 million dollars, combined with a contraction in industrial production, signals a weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to generate negative returns in 60% of cases.
